rationale: The persona favors generalist, natural-language interfaces over specialized, mechanistically grounded probe tools (preference 8), which points away from the indicator-probe option and toward the judge-model option. It also favors using the model's own representations (preference 7), which pulls the other way, and the judge option's filtering of incoherent responses is a form of curation he tends to avoid (preference 5). On balance the judge-based option fits better, but not decisively.
